content: Yakobodi Esau’walaŋ kahaŋ kuboneguk
Kaŋ Aisak adi hatigane me gawadaŋ tiŋa dawi gweheye hinek tubune nemek kedem mu yabuŋa mihiŋiŋ biyeniŋ kutniŋa niŋguk, “Mihine.” Adibo yoguk, “Nu yoŋ.”
Aisakdibo yoguk, “Nu agaŋ me gawadaaŋ tilat tiŋa kumuŋ naine mu nadilat.
Unduŋ doktiŋa du kale kaliŋ diniŋ bomboŋ tebe miŋ eŋ mihiniŋ moŋgola behepneŋ wooŋ kale neeŋ utnambeŋ.
Tiŋa kobaŋ na dibek nawe nadilat undiniŋ hinambeŋ kaŋ naaŋke kahaŋ tigamgidibaaŋ kumumbaat.”
Lebeka adi kabup yale magi kametnadi tulune Aisak adi mihiŋiŋ biyeniŋ dut mede yonadi tugumuk. Agaŋ Esau adi kale kaliŋ behepneŋ uguk.
Kaŋ Lebekadi mihiŋiŋ Yakobo indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadilaŋ be? Nu bahadi dake Esau indiŋ nimbune nadiŋat.
Du kale niŋ tinam buŋa nanaŋe kobaaŋ henambune naaŋke Wapum’walaŋ namanda foloŋ kahaŋ tigamgidibaaŋ kumumbaat.
Ale mihine, yoŋ adi ganindidimewene nadiŋa mede tiloloŋ tibeŋ.
Du indidegoŋ pilap wooŋ meme mihiniŋ maahi lufom moŋgola buŋa nambeŋ, kaŋ nu bahadok nanaŋe kobaaŋ hemimbit.
Kaŋ du bahadok timiŋa loweŋ kaŋ naaŋke kahaŋ tigamgidibaaŋ kumumbaak.”
Yakobodibo miiŋ Lebeka indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadiweŋ. Datne Esau adi folooŋ dumuniŋ nit, eŋ nu adi foloone gumoi.
Ala batnedi nobu nehinabek? Tiŋa nadiwek e nu tikamanda timilat unduŋ nehitubumintaaŋ kahaŋ tinamdok wabiŋa haaki tinambek kube.”
Miiŋdibo niŋguk, “Mihine. Haaki u biune nutok tibek. Du adi pilap wooŋ nemek ganilat u tibeŋ. Pilap wooŋ moŋgola bu nam!”
Unduŋ yobune mihi adi wooŋ moŋgokuk moŋgola buŋa miiŋdok miŋguk, kaŋ miiŋdi nanaŋe kobaaŋ beudi nawe nadilak undiniŋ heeŋ tiulidokomiŋguk.
Lebeka adi unduŋ tiŋa mihiŋiŋ biyeniŋ’walaŋ dahidahi niŋ ne’walaŋ yolineŋ hatuguk u tiŋa mihiŋiŋ kuyaniŋ Yakobo dahimiŋguk.
Miiŋ adi unduŋ tiŋa kohoŋ eŋ kodi gumoi u meme gitnemdi kufulaguk.
Miiŋ adi unduŋ tiŋa nanaŋe kobaaŋ eŋ belet tiulidokoguk u mihiŋiŋ Yokobo kohoŋ foloŋ boimiŋguk.
Yakobo adi beu’walaŋkade wooŋ yoguk, “Baatne.” Aisakdibo yoguk, “Woe, mihine. Du nedigoŋ?”
Yakobodibo beu niŋguk, “Nu Esau mihige biyeniŋ, nu mede yoŋaŋ wondok tuwolit tiŋat ale du pilale ila kalene naaŋ kahaŋ tinambeŋ.”
Aisakdi mihiŋiŋ ninadiguk, “Mihine, du dediŋ tiŋa pilap tubumintaŋaŋ?” Kibibo niŋguk, “Du’walaŋ Wapum Bepaŋdi pilap tubumintanamuŋak.”
Kaŋ Aisakdi Yakobo niŋguk, “Mihine, yamaŋgoŋ buune Esau biyagoŋ be yoŋa gohone gabit.”
Yakobo adi beu Aisak habeeŋ foloŋ uguk. Uune hone nadiŋa yoguk, “Maŋiŋ malap adi Yakobo’walaŋ maŋiŋ malap, iŋgoŋ kohoŋ adi Esau’walaŋ kohoŋ.”
Adi kohoŋ dumuniŋnit doktiŋa mu nadidakaleguk. Unduŋ tiŋa kahaŋ timiŋguk.
Tubudapmaaŋ indiŋ ninadiguk, “Du biyagoŋ hinek mihine Esau be?” Adibo yoguk, “Nu adigoŋ.”
Kaŋ adibo yoguk, “Mihine, kalege neeŋ moŋgotnambune nawit, naaŋke kahaŋne gambit.” Yakobo adi moŋgola wooŋ miŋguk kaŋ Aisakdi naguk, naune wain ime maaŋ mimbune naguk.
Tiŋa beu Aisakdi niŋguk, “Mihine, na itatneŋ iŋgoŋ buŋa siŋgoŋgome tinambeŋ.”

Kaŋ Yakobo adi wooŋ siŋgoŋgome tuguk. Unduŋ tubune beu Aisak adi dahidahiŋiŋ diniŋ munduŋ nadiŋa kahaŋ timiŋa yoguk, “Wa mihine diniŋ munduŋ adi behep munduŋ undiniŋ. Wapumdi behep kahaŋ tuguk ukuyoŋ.”

content.text: “Bepaŋ adi kunum mentok eŋ kwet diniŋ galiki tiŋa haŋgom eŋ wain duhuduhu wapum siloŋ tigambaak.

“Eŋ meeniŋ kwetkwet adi tipilapilaye tigamuneeŋ. Eŋ meeniŋ bop mohok adi du’walaŋkade duwokeneneŋ. Du daake kwayageye bomboŋgi tiyembaaŋ. Kaŋ maaŋge’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi duwokinegamuneeŋ. Du haaki tigamuneŋ adi haaki tiyemdok. Eŋ du kahaŋ tigamuneeŋ adi adi kahaŋ tiyemdok.”

content: Agaŋ Aisak adi Yakobo kahaŋ timimbune dapmaune Yakobo adi beu kweli biŋa uguk. Ulune Esau adi behepneŋ ugukdi udaneŋ busuaguk.
Adibo undugoŋ kale heeŋ beudok tiŋalooŋ niŋguk, “Baatne, du pilali mihige nu’walaŋ kale naaŋ kahaŋ tinambeŋ.”
Kaŋ beu Aisakdibo niŋguk, “Kei, du nedigoŋ!?” Kaŋ adibo yoguk, “Nu mihige tuwo biyeniŋ, Esau.”
Aisak adi sukule tiŋa boho hinek tiŋa yoguk, “Kaŋ du mu labune kale ula tilabuŋa nambune naaŋ kahaŋ timiŋat u nedi? Kahaŋ woŋ adi aditok fafaŋeniŋ halaak!”
Esau adi beu’walaŋ mede unduŋ nadiŋa makat kisaŋ kolaŋa beu niŋguk, “O Mebaŋ, nu maaŋ fiit kahaŋ tinambeŋ!”
Ingoŋ oŋ beudi yoguk, “Kwayage ne yalaŋ naniŋa du’walaŋ kahaŋ moŋgolaŋak!”

Yobune Esaudi yoguk, “Yopo hinek wou Yakobo yogiŋ, adi adi nalamut tubune nai lufom agaŋ tilak! Adi koom tuwo biyeniŋ diniŋ kahaŋ u nolom moŋgokuk agaŋ kamiŋ kahaŋne moŋgolaŋak.” U yodapmaŋ kotigoŋ yonadiguk. “Nutok kahaŋ neembe binamuŋaŋ?”

Aisakdibo Esau indiŋ niŋguk, “I nadiweŋ. Adi me bomboŋgi tigamdok nindapmaŋat. Eŋ dalikwayaŋiye adi adi tipilapilaye timindok yoŋat, haŋgom eŋ wain u maaŋ aditogoŋ yoŋat. Unduŋ doktiŋa mihine kada, dutok maŋgoŋ gambit?”
Esaudibo beu niŋguk, “O Mebaŋ, kahaŋ kubugoŋ hogok nemube hakamulak? Mebaŋ, nu maaŋ kahaŋ tinambeŋ!” Unduŋ yoŋa Esau maat wapum kookuk.
Unduŋ tubune beu Aisakdi mede indiŋ niŋguk,

content.text: “Du adi kwet galiki mu hatakneŋ eŋ kunum mentok mu malakneŋ yoke kwake undineŋ itouluwaaŋ.
Du adi mik kwadigedi nanaŋege tubumintagambaak. Kaŋ kwayage tipilapilaye timimbaaŋ, tiŋa indiŋ mintawaak. Du fafaŋe tiŋa gigine nobu tibaaŋ adi adi’walaŋ mulabumuŋ boboke ginaniŋ dilitelewaaŋ.”

content: Fiye 27:41-46 Esau eŋ Yakobo tububihila danegumuk.

Esau adi adi beudi Yakobo kahaŋ timiŋguk wondok tiŋa Yakobo nadikadaka timiŋguk. Tiŋa weleŋ ginaŋ indiŋ nadisuguk, “Baatne’walaŋ kobulabulaye nai dula tilak ale u dapmaune nu kwayane Yakobo ulukumuŋ tibaat.”
Kaŋ Lebeka adi mihiŋiŋ biyeniŋ’walaŋ mede u nimbihilune nadiŋa mihiŋiŋ mona nihamaneŋ mede indiŋ niŋguk, “Nadilaŋ be? Dake Esau adi kwihita wapum tiŋa kibikooŋ gulukumuŋ tibene yolak?
Ale, mihine indiŋ yobene nadiweŋ. Du pilap pilali momooŋ witne Laban Halan yokwetneŋ hatilak adi’walaŋ weŋ.
Tiŋa adut nai yagigi hatilune dake’walaŋ nadikwihita kwelemawaak.
Kwelemaune du nemek timiŋaŋ u kauleune nu dutok mede kame gambene nadiŋa udaneeŋ baaŋ. Hidi maŋgoŋde nai kubugoŋ wanaŋ liwenamundeemek?”

Lebeka adi unduŋ yoŋa Aisak indiŋ niŋguk, “Nu adi Hitait tamyat dut hatidok adi foloone gulida tilak. Ala tiyaugane Yakobodibo Hitait me adi’walaŋ wabi kwet iŋahi kuyoŋ nagilaak adi nu dediŋ tiŋa itouluwaat.”
